en:
## New Features

- Edit the text of an AI reply without deleting later messages or regenerating; the saved text flows into subsequent conversation history while the edit marker stays out of the AI payload.
- Restore an edited AI reply back to its original text in one click, which clears the "edited" badge so the message looks like it was never changed.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 支持直接编辑 AI 回复的文本，不会删除后续消息或重新生成；保存后的内容会用于后续对话历史，而「已编辑」标记不会发送给 AI。
- 编辑过的 AI 回复可一键恢复原文，恢复后「已编辑」标记消失，效果等同从未编辑。
